description:
Create, change or cancel a post. This publishes: a new post is queued for every account named and goes out at scheduled_at, or as soon as possible without one. Do not tell anyone their post is saved or scheduled until this has returned successfully.

No post_id creates a post. Name accounts with ids from accounts_list, or a group from groups_list for all of its members — the two combine, and a group is expanded now, so adding an account to it later does not add it to this post. Accounts must all be in one workspace. Attach media by id from media_list; a post is either a video or a set of images, never both. draft true holds it here without sending anything.

With post_id, changes a post that has not gone out: caption, time, destinations, or draft state. account_ids and groups then replace the destination list entirely. draft false sends a draft. Setting scheduled_at on a post whose destinations failed queues the failed ones again and leaves the published ones alone — fix what made them fail first, usually by reconnecting. The caption and destinations can only change while nothing has published; after that only the time can, and new words mean a new post.

With post_id and cancel true, stops it: destinations that have not started are cancelled, and any already being published cannot be recalled and come back in still_going. Safe to repeat.

Publishing has to be enabled on the account; where it is not, a new post saves nothing at all and a draft is left as it was, and the answer says so. Cancelling works whether or not publishing is enabled.

account_ids.description: Accounts to post to, from accounts_list. On a new post, optional when groups is given; naming neither is refused. On an existing post, replaces the destinations — send every account you want.

cancel.description: With post_id: stop the post before it goes out.

draft.description: True holds the post here: nothing is queued and nothing reaches any platform. On an existing post, false sends a draft and true returns a scheduled post to draft. Unrelated to the per-platform draft option, which uploads to the platform for the creator to finish.

groups.description: Group names from groups_list, expanded to their members and combined with account_ids. Matched without regard to case.

idempotency_key.description: New posts only. Reuse on retry to avoid posting twice; returns the original post.

media_ids.description: New posts only. Files to attach, in order — the slideshow order.

platform_options.description: New posts only. Per-platform settings, keyed by platform. Only the keys shown are accepted — an unknown key is refused rather than ignored. Call platforms_list for what each one does, its default, and which kind of post it applies to.

post_id.description: A post to change or cancel, from posts_list. Omit to create one.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601. Omit to send as soon as possible. A time in the past sends as soon as possible.

name: posts_save

cancelled.description: When cancelling: destinations stopped before they started.

still_going.description: When cancelling: destinations already in flight, which cannot be stopped.

title: Save a post
